# hetznerrobot_subnet_cancellation (Data Source)

Reads the cancellation data of a subnet. Fails when the subnet cannot be cancelled (e.g. a server's main IP).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_subnet_cancellation" "legacy" {
  ip = "178.63.123.120"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The subnet (for a subnet: its net address).

### Read-Only

- `cancellation_date` (String) Date of the active cancellation; null when none is active.
- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether a cancellation is active.
- `earliest_cancellation_date` (String) Earliest possible cancellation date.
- `mask` (String) Prefix length of the subnet.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the subnet belongs to.
